page.layout: One printed page (left-hand page of the opening, the right side is the binding edge and shows no text). Running head at top; main text in one column with line numbers 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30 beside the column (these are numerals belonging to the column, not notes); verse in italic indented lines; a marginal catchword-like marker "Lesbia]" set at the foot of the column; page number at top right.

main_text.p: ci:In quo totū est, in illo oportet & partes esse: In quibus partes sunt, & totū necesse est inesse. ibidem negationes oppositæ proponuntur: Si partium vel una desit, totum non esse: at contrà non sequi, Si totum non sit, nullam partem esse: hæc ἀκολουθητικὰ sunt Aristotelis. Quinta] Quidam disputabát é partibus formæ, Quintiam formosam esse, quia esset candida, longa, recta: at indu-ctione illam, ut sophisticá Catullus redarguit, quia pars una formæ desit, venustas nempe: itaque totum inficiatur: Atq; hic poeta artificium genusq; argumenti pené ipse explicat scholasti co more, Concedo partes istas singulas: totum illud, formosa, nego. Venustas] Venustas proprié est pulchritudo muliebris, ut dignitas pulchritudo virilis: hic autʼ significat gratiá & lepo-rem vel sermonis vel gestus. Nulla in tam] Alle-goria est á cibis insulsis & sine sale ingratis: Nâ sicut sal suavitatē quandā cum mordacitate habet: ita etiam urbanorū joca (ait Quintilianus.) Itaq; sales pro ridiculis & facetiis accipiūtur. Ergo Catulli argumētū est, Deest pars una formę, ergo tota forma nō est. idē Catullꝰ é sex partib. tollit totū in alio epigram. de amica Formiani:

l.i: Nec bello pede, nec nigris ocellis,
Nec longis digitis, nec ore sicco,

page.notes: Line-number markers 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30 stand in the column's right margin and are recorded here only as numerals. The word "Lesbia]" at the foot is a catchword-style marker. Marginal-looking numerals and the faint foot mark "n ʒ" are doubtful. Binding-side show-through and marbled endpapers are not transcribed. Greek word rendered as printed as best read: "ἀκολουθητικὰ" (doubtful).
